name: JoAi: List Element Variations

description.en: View all variations of an element in your team library, including their labels, aspect ratios, and generated images.
description.de: Zeige alle Variationen eines Elements in deiner Team-Bibliothek, inklusive Label, Seitenverhältnis und generierter Bilder.

bot: Use this when the user wants to see the variations, versions, or generated images of an element.

inputs.name: Element ID
inputs.bot: The ID of the element whose variations to list.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
